mapper.update: LOCK TABLE TB_SY_OPER_STD, TB_CL_CLOSE, TB_CO_PART_SETL, TB_BS_PART, TB_BS_PART_STD, TB_SY_USER, TB_SY_USER_ROLE, TB_SY_ROLE, TB_HR_DEV, TB_PJ_PROJ, TB_PJ_PROJ_PART, TB_SY_CHG_HIST, TB_HR_MON_PAY, TB_HR_DEV_PRC, TB_PJ_ASGN, TB_PJ_ASGN_MON, TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST, TB_PJ_TK_DSTRB, TB_CO_MON_COST, TB_CO_PART_SETL_DTL, TB_SY_CODE, TB_SY_CALC_RULE, TB_HR_DEV_STAT, TB_BL_BILL, TB_PJ_DRCT_EXPS, TB_FI_ITEM, TB_FI_CORP_TAX, TB_CO_PREV_ADJ, TB_CO_MON_PL, TB_CL_CLOSE_HIST IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT
mapper.select: SELECT c.CLOSE_STAT_CD AS "state", c.MOD_DTTM AS "modifiedAt", c.CLOSE_DTTM AS "closedAt", COALESCE(u.USER_NM, c.CLOSE_USER_ID) AS "closedBy" FROM TB_CL_CLOSE c LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER u ON u.USER_ID = c.CLOSE_USER_ID WHERE c.CLOSE_YM = #{month}
SELECT max(CLOSE_YM) FROM TB_CL_CLOSE WHERE CLOSE_STAT_CD = 'CLOSE'

SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM TB_HR_MON_PAY WHERE PAY_YM = #{month}) AS "payroll", (SELECT count(*)::int FROM TB_BL_BILL WHERE BILL_YM = #{month} AND CNCL_YN = 'N' AND (TAX_INVC_NO IS NULL OR btrim(TAX_INVC_NO) = '')) AS "invoices", (SELECT count(*)::int FROM TB_FI_ITEM WHERE FIN_YM = #{month}) AS "finance"
SELECT count(*)::int FROM TB_CO_PREV_ADJ WHERE APLY_YM = #{next} AND TRGT_YM = #{month}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CL_CLOSE(CLOSE_YM, CLOSE_STAT_CD, CLOSE_USER_ID, CLOSE_DTTM, REG_USER_ID, REG_DTTM, MOD_USER_ID, MOD_DTTM) VALUES(#{month}, #{state}, #{actor}, clock_timestamp(), #{actor}, clock_timestamp(), #{actor}, clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT(CLOSE_YM) DO UPDATE SET CLOSE_STAT_CD = excluded.CLOSE_STAT_CD, CLOSE_USER_ID = CASE WHEN excluded.CLOSE_STAT_CD = 'CLOSE' THEN excluded.CLOSE_USER_ID ELSE NULL END, CLOSE_DTTM = CASE WHEN excluded.CLOSE_STAT_CD = 'CLOSE' THEN excluded.CLOSE_DTTM ELSE NULL END, MOD_USER_ID = excluded.MOD_USER_ID, MOD_DTTM = GREATEST(clock_timestamp(), COALESCE(TB_CL_CLOSE.MOD_DTTM, TB_CL_CLOSE.REG_DTTM) + interval '1 microsecond') WHERE TB_CL_CLOSE.MOD_DTTM IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{version,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}

INSERT INTO TB_CL_CLOSE_HIST(CLOSE_YM, HIST_SN, ACT_CD, ACT_RSN, REMAIN_CHK_CN, REG_USER_ID, REG_DTTM) SELECT #{month}, COALESCE(max(HIST_SN), 0) + 1, #{action}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remaining,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{actor}, clock_timestamp() FROM TB_CL_CLOSE_HIST WHERE CLOSE_YM = #{month}
INSERT INTO TB_SY_ACCS_LOG(USER_ID, ACT_TYPE_CD, SCRN_ID, TRGT_DESC, ACT_DTTM, REG_USER_ID, REG_DTTM) VALUES(#{actor}, #{action}, 'UI-14', #{month}, clock_timestamp(), #{actor}, clock_timestamp())
INSERT INTO TB_CL_CLOSE(CLOSE_YM, CLOSE_STAT_CD, REG_USER_ID, REG_DTTM) VALUES(#{month}, 'WORK', #{actor}, clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT(CLOSE_YM) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO TB_CL_CLOSE_CHK(CLOSE_YM, CHK_ITEM_CD, CHK_STAT_CD, CHK_CNT, CHK_CN, LINK_SCRN_ID, CHK_DTTM, REG_USER_ID, REG_DTTM, MOD_USER_ID, MOD_DTTM) SELECT #{month}, v.item, v.status, v.cnt, v.content, v.screen, clock_timestamp(), #{actor}, clock_timestamp(), #{actor}, clock_timestamp() FROM (VALUES
(CAST(#{check.itemCode} AS VARCHAR), CAST(#{check.statusCode} AS VARCHAR), CAST(#{check.count} AS NUMERIC), CAST(#{check.description,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS VARCHAR), CAST(#{check.screenId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS VARCHAR)) ) AS v(item, status, cnt, content, screen) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_CL_CLOSE c WHERE c.CLOSE_YM = #{month} AND c.CLOSE_STAT_CD = 'WORK') ON CONFLICT(CLOSE_YM, CHK_ITEM_CD) DO UPDATE SET CHK_STAT_CD = excluded.CHK_STAT_CD, CHK_CNT = excluded.CHK_CNT, CHK_CN = excluded.CHK_CN, LINK_SCRN_ID = excluded.LINK_SCRN_ID, CHK_DTTM = excluded.CHK_DTTM, MOD_USER_ID = excluded.MOD_USER_ID, MOD_DTTM = excluded.MOD_DTTM
mapper.select: SELECT count(*)::int FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON WHERE INPUT_YM = #{month} AND FIX_YN = 'Y'
SELECT count(*)::int FROM TB_CO_MON_COST WHERE COST_YM = #{month} AND FIX_YN = 'Y'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON WHERE INPUT_YM = #{month} AND FIX_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PJ_ASGN_MON(ASGN_ID, INPUT_YM, DEV_ID, PROJ_ID, INPUT_DAY_CNT, MON_MM, APLY_UPRC, SALES_AMT, FIX_YN, REG_USER_ID, MOD_USER_ID, MOD_DTTM) VALUES(#{assignmentId}, #{month}, #{developerId}, #{projectId}, #{days}, #{mm}, #{price}, #{sales}, 'Y', #{actor}, #{actor}, clock_timestamp())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_CO_MON_COST WHERE COST_YM = #{month} AND FIX_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CO_MON_COST(COST_YM, DEV_ID, PROJ_ID, ASGN_ID, ASGN_MM, FREE_MM, SALES_AMT, LABOR_ALLOC_AMT, TEAM_EXPS_AMT, PROJ_EXPS_AMT, DRCT_EXPS_AMT, COST_CLS_CD, CTRT_TYPE_CD, PART_ID, FIX_YN, REG_USER_ID, MOD_USER_ID, MOD_DTTM) VALUES(#{row.yearMonth}, #{row.developerId}, #{row.projectId}, #{row.assignmentId}, #{row.mm}, CASE WHEN #{row.inputTypeCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'FREE' THEN #{row.mm} ELSE 0 END, #{row.revenue}, #{row.labor}, #{row.team}, #{row.expense}, #{row.team} + #{row.expense}, #{classification}, #{row.contractTypeCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{partId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y', #{actor}, #{actor}, clock_timestamp())

INSERT INTO TB_CO_MON_PL(PL_YM, SALES_AMT, ALLOC_COST_AMT, IDLE_COST_AMT, DRCT_EXPS_AMT, SALES_COST_AMT, GROSS_PRFT_AMT, SGA_INPUT_AMT, INDRCT_LABOR_AMT, RND_AMT, SGA_TOT_AMT, PREV_ADJ_AMT, OPRT_PRFT_AMT, NOPR_INCM_AMT, NOPR_EXPS_AMT, CORP_TAX_AMT, NET_PRFT_AMT, MIGR_YN, FIX_YN, REG_USER_ID, MOD_USER_ID, MOD_DTTM) VALUES(#{row.month}, #{row.revenue}, #{row.allocatedCost}, #{row.idleCost}, #{row.directExpense}, #{row.costOfSales}, #{row.grossProfit}, #{row.sellingAdministrativeInput}, #{row.indirectLaborCost}, #{row.internalResearchCost}, #{row.sga}, #{row.previousAdjustment}, #{row.operatingProfit}, #{row.income}, #{row.expense}, #{row.tax}, #{row.netProfit}, 'N', 'Y', #{actor}, #{actor}, clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT(PL_YM) DO UPDATE SET SALES_AMT = excluded.SALES_AMT, ALLOC_COST_AMT = excluded.ALLOC_COST_AMT, IDLE_COST_AMT = excluded.IDLE_COST_AMT, DRCT_EXPS_AMT = excluded.DRCT_EXPS_AMT, SALES_COST_AMT = excluded.SALES_COST_AMT, GROSS_PRFT_AMT = excluded.GROSS_PRFT_AMT, SGA_INPUT_AMT = excluded.SGA_INPUT_AMT, INDRCT_LABOR_AMT = excluded.INDRCT_LABOR_AMT, RND_AMT = excluded.RND_AMT, SGA_TOT_AMT = excluded.SGA_TOT_AMT, PREV_ADJ_AMT = excluded.PREV_ADJ_AMT, OPRT_PRFT_AMT = excluded.OPRT_PRFT_AMT, NOPR_INCM_AMT = excluded.NOPR_INCM_AMT, NOPR_EXPS_AMT = excluded.NOPR_EXPS_AMT, CORP_TAX_AMT = excluded.CORP_TAX_AMT, NET_PRFT_AMT = excluded.NET_PRFT_AMT, MIGR_YN = 'N', FIX_YN = 'Y', MOD_USER_ID = excluded.MOD_USER_ID, MOD_DTTM = clock_timestamp() WHERE TB_CO_MON_PL.FIX_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PJ_ASGN_MON SET FIX_YN = 'N' WHERE INPUT_YM = #{month} AND FIX_YN = 'Y'
UPDATE TB_CO_MON_COST SET FIX_YN = 'N' WHERE COST_YM = #{month} AND FIX_YN = 'Y'
UPDATE TB_CO_MON_PL SET FIX_YN = 'N' WHERE PL_YM = #{month} AND FIX_YN = 'Y'
